# Nitemare3D Win16 1.10 — passes53–54, zero-write handling and complete text writer

## Finding
Confirmed, High within the specified simulated OS boundary:24,576 zero-write/error helper executions close the previously blocked pass53. Pass54 adds2,068 successful executions of the complete5902 writer, plus5 complete-caller zero-write Ctrl+Z cases. Original code converts LF to CRLF and returns logical input length for full writes. With first input byte1A and descriptor bit40, a zero-byte successful service can return the nonzero AH left byLAHF. This is reachable from the original5902 entry under the modeled OS response, not yet observed on a real Windows device.

## Pass53: exact scope and values
8 request sizes(1,2,3,7,20,32767,32768,65535) ×3 descriptor bytes(00,40,FF) ×all256 first input bytes ×4 OS results(success0,error5,error6,error255)=24,576 cases. Existing synthetic caller frame has zero cumulative wordBP-4; second subtraction operandBP-6 zero. InputDX0 allows each selected WORD request length without pointer addition overflow. Original source pointerBP+8 is6000, whose first byte is independently varied. The OS stub does not consume that potentially large request buffer; it returns selectedAX andCF. Therefore these fixtures establish instruction behavior, not actual device buffer semantics.

The helper's zero-success path performsCMP(request,0), thenLAHF savesSF/ZF/AF/PF/CF intoAH. SAHF restores flags but does not restore the previousAH. The device/first-byte tests do not changeAX. CLC then passes to3D41, which takes its success branch. Its stack epilogue also does not changeAX. Thus the finalAX is the saved flag byte shifted8, not zero. Examples:request1→0200,request3→0600,request20→0600,request8000→8600. Pass53 verifies each selected request across all byte/device/error combinations. On the Ctrl+Z success path errno085E and raw error086E remain unchanged. SP,BP,DS,SI,DI and finalAX checked. CF is captured at3D41 before its later stack arithmetic can change flags; no claim is made that the final far-returnCF equals that capturedCF.

## Pass54: original complete caller and text conversion
The test starts at1008:5902, not59DC. It runs original prologue, descriptor dispatch, LF scan, stack-availability helper5A9C, dynamic128/512-byte temporary-buffer selection, conversion/flush loops, shared tail,3D41 and original far return. The only relocation adjustment is the selector WORD at5987 of the originalCALLF5A9C, set to testCS2000. DirectINT21 is selected throughCS370E=0; descriptorC0 selects text/device without append. No CRT helper is replaced.

Successful fixtures:9 specific inputs(empty,A,LF,CRLF,Ctrl+Z+LF,1024LFs,511A+LF,512A+LF,127A+LF), plus1,025 seed54 random inputs of every length0..1024. Run each with two stack-reserve configurations:2,068 cases. Entire emitted byte stream must equal input.replace(LF,CRLF), and returnedAX must equal original byte length. Source bytes and savedSP/BP/DS/SI/DI checked. This establishes the second frame word's role as the inserted-CR count on this caller path:59C7 incrementsBP-6 once per LF; shared5A40 subtracts it from the successful physical-byte sumBP-4.

Five additional complete-caller tests begin with1A, containLF, and receive simulatedAX0/CF0 at the first write. All take the special success route. Inputs1A0A (physical request3) return0600;1A410A (request4) return0200; requests5,6,18 return0600. These are verified instruction outcomes under a controlled zero-success service, not evidence of a demonstrated real-world game defect.

146 distinct executed instruction starts in pass54 are compared to the recovered native Ghidra12.2 listing and original EXE bytes. At5984 the opcode/offset match and relocated selector adjustment is declared. All other executed encodings match directly. Pass53 also checks native encodings in its helper and epilogue range, excluding the unexecuted DOS3CALL relocation. Original EXE SHA256:12fe5168783446275802e0e947898261b5eca6b88288f3a895fc1faa4c544481. Unicorn2.1.4,16-bit mode,CS2000,DS=SS1048. The scripts reproduce tests from original EXE and previously saved native listing; no fresh Ghidra run or database modification is claimed in these two passes.

## Implementation-ready findings
For5902 text mode, count CR insertions and subtract them from the physical successful write sum. Keep direct byte-output mode separate. Model zero-progress handling with its exact descriptor/first-byte guard; a blanket return0 for Ctrl+Z is not instruction-equivalent. Preserve the residualAH only when reproducing this exact CRT path. Do not infer that every game file write or OS device reaches it.

## Unknowns and next tests
1. Append positioning(AH4202), including seek failure before conversion.
2. Extended-handle73C5 and DOS3CALL alternatives.
3. Full caller short writes and errors across CR insertion/buffer flush boundaries.
4. Small-stack fatal path through39F2 and actual Windows fatal APIs.
5. Real Win16 file/device execution and full-game parity, including SAVE/LOAD first frame, remain open.

The broad Win110 analysis remains ongoing. No semantic completeness percentage is inferred from test counts or decompile success. Prior code-gap baseline1401 undefined executable bytes is not changed by these tests. Confirmed scope totals26,649 controlled cases; these do not constitute whole-game runtime parity.
